articles.title: Crypto rails are becoming the default payment layer for AI agents, report says
articles.snippet: A new report from Keyrock says stablecoins on blockchain rails are becoming the go-to payment layer for AI agents as traditional card rails struggle to handle micropayments.

articles.title: StablR Euro and USD stablecoins depeg amid ongoing $2.8M exploit
articles.snippet: Blockaid said the suspected cause is a private key compromise of one owner in the minting multisig account.

articles.title: ECB pushes back on euro stablecoin proposals, citing financial stability risks
articles.snippet: The ECB warned EU finance ministers that expanding euro stablecoin issuance could weaken bank lending and complicate monetary policy.

articles.title: Ethereum is still a good long-term buy, according data: Analyst
articles.snippet: Ethereum’s dominance in DeFi, stablecoins and staking is strengthening the long-term ETH accumulation thesis, despite it’s 28% price decline in 2026.
